title: TriggerPoint GRID 1.0 Foam Roller — Camo

comparisons.notes: Camo selected on manufacturer’s live page; Add to cart enabled. Single-item price; multi-item promotions require additional purchases.
Camo 13-inch model in publicly indexed listing. This lower comparison is retained conservatively; its price and shipping were not revalidated in checkout.

writeup: The GRID uses a hollow core and textured foam exterior, giving it a different feel from a solid smooth foam roller. Woot’s $9.99 is 71% below the lower $34.99 public comparison we found, while the manufacturer’s live Camo selection was $39.99. This is the compact original GRID, so check its size before choosing it over a longer roller.
notes: The manufacturer comparison was checked directly with Camo selected. Walmart’s lower indexed price is included to avoid overstating the savings, but may have changed. Woot lists a 90-day limited warranty; shipping and taxes are excluded.
